name: Agent Storefront
description: Nine pay-per-call services an agent can buy with USDC on Base mainnet, no account or API key: deterministic site audits (COOKED), claim checks against US government data that never bill INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (Tensorust), a live X reply-opportunity feed, printable PDF objects and paper prototypes (Desk Idols), and protected Vercel deploys with automatic rollback (SafeCommit).
